thread:
maria: Quick question about epoched lease serialization — should we treat lease as a purely in-proxy header (fast, ephemeral) or persist epoch+seq into the KV so cutover ordering survives proxy restarts? thinking about multi-region preemption safety.

sahil: We currently inject epoch+seq into the x-lease header from proxy, yes. Fast path avoids an extra write but doesn't survive proxy crash / replay.

leo: If header-only, how do we prevent two regions from both thinking they hold write lease after a network partition heals? need a durable tie-breaker.

anne: Agree. Putting the canonical epoch into KV gives us linearizable proof of last-lease, but costs a write on acquire. Tradeoff: latency vs safety.

maria: Right. Example of what I mean (proto sketch):

anne: ```proto
message Lease {
  uint64 epoch = 1;
  uint64 seq = 2; // monotonic per-epoch
  string owner_region = 3;
}
// proxy header: x-lease: epoch=42;seq=1234;owner=us-west-2
```

ken: Another option: keep header for fast routing, but on any contested acquire do a conditional KV write of epoch only (compare-and-swap). That makes the common case cheap.

sahil: Yeah, CAS on epoch is promising. Need to define semantics: epoch always increases on explicit handoff or on preemptive bump after timeout.

leo: Also need monotonic seq semantics for in-flight requests: if a proxy restarts it must resume seq generator from persisted high-watermark or risk duplicate ordering.

maria: Operationally, two concrete proposals: A) Header-only + on-contest CAS epoch in KV. B) Always persist epoch on every lease transition (simpler correctness, higher cost). Which do we prefer for Dedicated workloads vs Hosted ones?

anne: For Dedicated (SLA customers) I lean B — pay cost for durability. For Hosted default, A seems fine if we add metrics to catch contested upgrades.

ken: We should also document downgrade behavior: if KV epoch > header epoch, proxy should reject writes with 409 and trigger refresh.

maria: Good call. Can someone run a quick sim: header-only with contest CAS vs full-persist across a partition/rejoin scenario and measure p99 for lease acquire + failover correctness? small harness should do.

sahil: I can wire a simulation this week, will push results to the RFC thread.

runtime-bot: CI note: please add unit tests for lease CAS and restart resume path.

maria: Thanks — assigning follow-ups: @sahil sim, @anne add proto + docs, @leo write restart-resume test vectors. Will reconvene after sim. :+1:

ken: Quick nanny note — add telemetry: contested_acquires, cas_failures, header_mismatch_count. That will help opt-in/fallback decisions.

maria: Perfect. Resolving for now, will update RFC with experiment plan.
